/item/49192693.title: DeepSeek announced to raise its API price tremendously
/item/49192693.content: My take: this notice from DeepSeek might actually be a brilliant marketing move. The logic here is to urge users to ramp up their usage over the next 2 to 3 months. By the time the price hike actually kicks in, newer models will likely have already drawn users away, and whenever DeepSeek drops its next, even stronger model, the new price point won't feel nearly as steep. It’s a clever way to dodge the dilemma Kimi and GLM found themselves in. Let's wait and see how it plays out.
